_comment: PER-AREA MONSTER TABLE (LEDGER debt row 77, first payment, M4-S3): the spawn rows MonsterField builds, replacing the M4-slice code constant {mchy: pokrzywnik}. One entry per area key; each row {kind, count, placement}: kind = a data/monsters.json key (Sim Attack looks it up there), count = idle sprites in the row, placement = 'near-spawn' (Chebyshev <= 3 from the arrival cell) | 'deep' (>= 5 from it; the 4-ring between may stay empty). An empty band falls back to all walkable cells; a town spawns nothing whatever this file says (isTown gate first). mchy: pokrzywnik count 14 (M4-S4: the level-up beat needs >=11 kills to cross the ladder L1->L2 threshold 500 xp at 40 xp/kill — 14 leaves margin), ponurak (art committed at assets/raw/mon-ponurak-idle.png) roams deep, count 2. Acts 2-5 rows are skeleton-valid placeholders on the first wilderness region of each act. M4-S9b (ORCH-RULING 2026-11-01, the world is WALKED): act-1's walked rites got their own rows — pokrzywlasy (wrzeciono's goal, stone-less ground): pokrzywnik near-spawn 3 + Kikimora's own kind kikimora deep 2 (the rite's namesake keeps the deep band); kopcowisko (dary's goal): ponurak near-spawn 3 + kretownik deep 2 (mole-folk in the mounds). czelusc DEFENDERS (MC 11954 — balance ORIGINAL DESIGN fenced per the D1 weapon-curve precedent; the reference lair was read for SHAPE only, never kinds or cells, R2 wall): the glowa rite's lair goal had NO row — the stash leg printed MONSTER_SPAWN_NONE there, the honest base fact this beat turns. strzyga near-spawn 3 + widlast deep 2: the two art-debt deep-area kinds (LEDGER row 85 D3/D4 — renders NOT required, the placeholder pass is the established idiom, the kikimora/kretownik precedent), EXISTING roster stat rows riding the existing depth curve (ownLevel 6/8 @ lair level 8); count/density copied from kopcowisko (3 near + 2 deep, total 5); the boss leszy (boss:true, keepsOwnLevel) stays OUT — a fresh-monster-per-kill field would farm the rite final. Cells-in-bounds + band legality + the exact 5-sprite row are pinned by tests/CzeluscDefenderTests.cs (RED-first on the rowless base). Seed stays Fnv.Hash(area + ':mon'); rows build in file order. Loaded through the GameContext.DataDir() surface; one-way copy to game/data/ — never hand-edit the copy.
